scheme: rolling-origin: calibrate on the 28 days before each month

pairing.note: Regional and national series join on the slot timestamp. If a source is reformatted, pairs drop silently and coverage would be measured on fewer slots; this block makes that visible.

regime_conditional.note: Conformal on the absolute residual, one quantile per intensity regime (edges in INTENSITY_EDGES). Keeps the guarantee inside each regime instead of averaging over all of them.

residual_structure.note: Error is not proportional to intensity: |error| grows with the level while |error|/forecast falls. That is why a single relative band misallocates width.

alignment.note: Same-slot pairing (shift 0) is the documented one and is what every number here uses. The best-shift column only shows how much of the residual could be a timestamp convention rather than forecast error; the optimum was not stable across windows, so no shift is applied.

decision_relevance.note: A proportional band cannot reorder regions; it sets how large a carbon gap must be before routing is defensible. threshold_ratio is (1-q)/(1+q); band_robust_pct is the share of slots where the best site's upper bound is below the runner-up's lower bound.
